title: Publish kanso-jetbrains and offer it upstream
description:
Status: 0.1.0 builds and passes nix flake check (palette drift, merged-theme tests: no stock colors, UI text >= 4.5:1, code >= 3:1) and Plugin Verifier against IU-263.7307.200 (Compatible). A one-time look in IDEA 2026.3 on Mini showed Kanso Pearl and its scheme applied.

Next: 1) the owner checks Pearl and Mist on Delcatty under office light; 2) with approval, create the public GitHub repository (no remote exists yet) and ask webhooked whether kanso.nvim wants the port; 3) optionally publish to JetBrains Marketplace; 4) then switch Delcatty's IntelliJ in nixos-config (nixos-config-f999e4).
